Reference
# Pressure Washing & Restoration Glossary
Plain-English definitions of the terms used in pressure washing, blasting, masonry restoration and elevator pit cleaning.
- Since 199828 years in business
- 7,500+properties cleaned
- $5Mliability insured
- WSIBcovered & ISSA-GBAC
- 4.9 / 5rated on Google
Abrasive blastingDriving a stream of abrasive media (sand, glass, garnet, soda, walnut shell and others) at a surface under pressure to strip rust, paint, scale or coatings. Learn more →
Acid washCleaning masonry with a diluted acid-based cleaner to dissolve mortar smears and mineral stains. It must be tested, correctly diluted and neutralised. Learn more →
Anti-graffiti coatingA clear protective coating that makes graffiti easier to remove. Sacrificial coatings come off with the graffiti; permanent coatings stay in place. Learn more →
Buffer (elevator)The spring or oil device at the bottom of an elevator pit that stops a car or counterweight travelling past its normal limit. Pit debris and corrosion around buffers is a common clean-up item. Learn more →
Dry ice blastingBlasting with frozen carbon dioxide pellets that turn to gas on impact, removing coatings and residue without leaving abrasive media behind. Learn more →
Dustless blastingWet abrasive blasting where water is mixed with the media to suppress airborne dust. Learn more →
EfflorescenceA white, powdery salt deposit left on brick, concrete, stone or pavers when water moves through the material and evaporates at the surface. Learn more →
Elevator pitThe space at the bottom of an elevator hoistway, below the lowest landing, housing buffers and other equipment. It collects debris, water and oil. Learn more →
Hot-water pressure washingPressure washing with heated water, often called power washing, which cuts through oil, grease and gum faster than cold water. Learn more →
Hydro jettingUsing very high-pressure water streams to scour build-up from inside pipes, condensers and lines. Learn more →
Lime runHard white calcium carbonate deposits that streak from mortar joints, harder to remove than ordinary efflorescence. Learn more →
Micro blastingPrecision blasting with very fine media at low pressure, used on detailed or delicate masonry and stubborn coatings. Learn more →
PoulticeA paste applied to stone or brick that draws stains or paint ghosting out of the pores as it dries. Learn more →
Polymeric sandJoint sand for interlock pavers mixed with binders that harden when misted with water, resisting washout and weeds. Learn more →
Pressure washingCleaning with high-pressure water to remove dirt, grime and stains from durable surfaces like concrete and interlock. Learn more →
Soda blastingBlasting with sodium bicarbonate, a soft media suited to delicate surfaces, soot and light coatings. Learn more →
Soft washingLow-pressure cleaning that uses biodegradable cleaners to kill and remove algae, mould and mildew from siding, stucco and roofs. Learn more →
SpallingFlaking or popping of the surface of brick, stone or concrete, often caused by trapped moisture freezing and thawing. Learn more →
Sump pumpA pump in a pit or basin that removes collected water. In elevator pits, sumps must be covered and working to prevent flooding. Learn more →
Surface cleanerA rotary attachment for pressure washers that cleans flat surfaces evenly without the stripes a bare wand leaves. Learn more →
WSIB clearance certificateA document from Ontario's Workplace Safety and Insurance Board confirming a contractor's account is in good standing. Learn more →

Who we are
# About Living Water Pressure Wash Services
Meticulous care for every surface — professional pressure washing and sandblasting in Toronto and the GTA since 1998.
- Since 199828 years in business
- 7,500+properties cleaned
- $5Mliability insured
- WSIBcovered & ISSA-GBAC
- 4.9 / 5rated on Google
Living Water Pressure Wash Services Ltd. is a Toronto-area pressure washing, sandblasting and surface restoration company founded in 1998. It has cleaned 7,500+ residential, commercial, industrial and heritage properties, and is $5M insured, WSIB covered and ISSA-GBAC certified.
When your property needs expert care, you want a team that shows up prepared and delivers results that last. That is what Living Water has done for more than 28 years. From residential driveways to heritage building facades, we bring the same precision and professionalism to every job.
Our clients — homeowners, business owners, property managers and heritage conservators — trust us with their most valuable assets, and we take that responsibility seriously.
See our before-and-after gallery, read customer reviews, browse the industries we serve, or get answers in our FAQ and glossary.
## What sets us apart
- Honesty in everything we say and quote
- Expert technique with top-quality equipment matched to each surface
- Environmentally responsible methods that protect the spaces around your property
- Long-term relationships — many clients have been with us for decades

Questions
## Questions before you book
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
How quickly can Living Water start?
Residential jobs are usually booked within 2–5 days, and same-week service is standard. Commercial and industrial clients get 24/7 emergency response on (647) 833-4343.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes. Living Water is fully licensed in Ontario, carries $5 million in commercial general liability insurance, is WSIB covered and ISSA-GBAC certified. We send a Certificate of Insurance to your property manager, condo board or HOA on request.
Will pressure washing damage my driveway, brick or siding?
Not when it is done right. We match the pressure, nozzle, water temperature and chemistry to each surface — interlock, brick, vinyl, stucco, stone and wood all need different approaches. Where high pressure is wrong we soft wash, steam or use media blasting instead.
Do you do commercial and industrial work?
Yes — refineries, plants, silos and tanks, heritage restoration, graffiti removal, sandblasting and elevator pit cleaning. Many of our clients are property managers, general contractors and municipalities. Our crews are certified boom and scissor lift operators.
What areas do you serve?
Toronto and the entire Greater Toronto Area, including Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Richmond Hill, Oakville, Burlington, Pickering, Ajax, Whitby and Oshawa, plus Hamilton, Niagara, Guelph, Cambridge, Barrie and Simcoe County.
Is the quote free?
Yes. Assessments are free and no-obligation, and you receive a fixed written quote before any work starts.

## Service area FAQ

Do you serve my city?
Living Water serves the City of Toronto (including North York, Scarborough, Etobicoke and East York), Peel and Halton (Mississauga, Brampton, Oakville, Burlington, Milton), York Region (Vaughan, Woodbridge, Maple, Kleinburg, Richmond Hill, Markham, King City, Aurora, Newmarket, Georgina), Durham Region (Pickering, Ajax, Whitby, Oshawa), Hamilton, Niagara, Guelph, Cambridge, Barrie and Simcoe County.
Do you charge extra for travel outside Toronto?
Your quote is a fixed written price that already accounts for location. Call us for projects outside the listed areas — larger commercial and heritage projects across Ontario are considered.
How quickly can you get to my property?
Residential work is usually booked within 2–5 days across the GTA. Emergency and disaster restoration is answered 24/7 on (647) 833-4343.

# Health & Safety Policy
- Since 199828 years in business
- 7,500+properties cleaned
- $5Mliability insured
- WSIBcovered & ISSA-GBAC
- 4.9 / 5rated on Google
Living Water is committed to protecting our employees, clients and the public on every job we undertake. Safety is planned into every quote, not added afterwards.
- Full WSIB coverage and $5M commercial general liability insurance
- Certificate of Insurance and WSIB clearance supplied before work starts
- Certified boom and scissor lift operators
- Site-specific hazard assessment, containment and protection of people, plants and property
- Proper handling and disposal of chemicals, oil and hazardous waste
- ISSA-GBAC certified cleaning and disinfection practices
The policy applies to all employees, subcontractors and on-site personnel across all service divisions. To request the full Health & Safety Policy document, email info@livingwater-pws.com.

# Privacy Policy
- Since 199828 years in business
- 7,500+properties cleaned
- $5Mliability insured
- WSIBcovered & ISSA-GBAC
- 4.9 / 5rated on Google
## Who we are
This website, https://livingwater-pws.com/, is operated by Living Water Pressure Wash Services Ltd.
## Information we collect
When you request a quote we collect the details you provide — name, email, phone number, location and project information — so we can respond. Our web host may log standard technical data such as IP address and browser type for security.
## Confidentiality and use
We keep your personal information confidential. We do not send unsolicited emails or sell your contact information. Information is used only to respond to you and provide our services.
## Form processing
Quote requests are delivered to our inbox by a third-party form service, which processes the data only to deliver it to us.
## Cookies
This site does not use advertising or tracking cookies.
## Your rights
You may ask for a copy of the personal information we hold about you, or ask us to delete it, subject to legal record-keeping obligations.
## Contact us
Questions about this policy: info@livingwater-pws.com or (416) 663-8000.
